the study of complex spatio–temporal dynamics and bifurcation in neural systems and its application to the study of perceptual competition.
the study of perceptual multistability, a phenomenon in which the brain switches between alternate interpretations of a single stimulus.
the modelling of neural dynamics in the context of perceptual multistability.
